rca of the issue: RCA already documented by main agent: CRA's html-webpack-plugin minifies inline scripts via terser, renaming the literal `ttq` local var to a short alias (e.g., `o`). TikTok's verification crawler performs a literal substring match for `ttq.load("PIXEL_ID")`, so the minified `o.load(...)` no longer matched. Fix: move snippet to /public/tiktok-pixel.js (webpack never touches /public) and reference via external <script src>. Verified: served file contains literal `ttq.load('D8UP6SJC77UCR7H8US60')`, runtime pixel registers, PageView POSTs fire, and SPA navigation triggers additional page() calls.
